unresolved_gaps: The cited 2023 report does not isolate generative AI's earnings contribution.
An unchanged share exceeding an EBIT threshold does not demonstrate zero financial gains.
The retrospective 2023 benefit figures measure business functions, not organization-wide earnings net of implementation costs.
The wording supplies no prevalence threshold for a broad conclusion.
